name: arch_window
description: Arched window unit (拱窗): glass panes with an upside-down-stair arch head, optional sill. Sizes 1x2 (arrow slit) or 2x3 (proper arch).
when_to_use: Every window the style card describes as 1x2/2x3 with rhythm. Punch the opening in the wall first (fill air), then run this per window with origin = bottom-left cell of the opening as seen from outside.

origin.notes: bottom-left cell of the opening, seen from outside

facing.notes: outward direction of the wall face; south/north = opening runs along x, east/west = along z

frame_material.notes: stairs used for the arch head

sill_material.notes: optional slab row under the window
